events.title: Italy's 유벤투스 FC wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 , Japan by defeating Argentina 's 아르헨티노스 주니어스 on penalties (4–2), after the match ended in 2-2. The Torinese side become the first—and remained the only until 2022 —team in the world to have won all possible official continental competitions and the world title .
